name: general_light_curve_benchmark_dataset_collection_tess_transiting_planet_dataset
description: A collection of TESS light-curve examples for transiting-planet detection and related time-series tasks. It is intended to benchmark algorithms for transit detection, classification of light-curve signals, and related anomaly/time-series analyses in astronomy. The dataset is used to evaluate model ability to identify planetary transit signatures and separate them from stellar variability and instrumental/systematic noise.
reputation: Public Hugging Face dataset used in niche astrophysics/time-series ML work with modest community uptake.
